summary: Jake, 34, New York: Wine Fridays with Sam are his, creatine is well-founded but unfelt, Equinox is really about the sauna. Tests a launch week and a short night reshaped without touching Friday.

progress.name: Jake
progress.lifeText: Up at 6 for a run along the Hudson, deep work until lunch, then actually leaving the office by 7 to cook dinner with Sam. Weekends I want to be outside, not on my laptop.

notes.text: Mostly go for the sauna after work honestly. It's the only 20 minutes where nobody can Slack me.
5g a day, Huberman said so. No idea if it does anything.
Fridays Sam and I open a bottle and cook something ambitious. Phones in the drawer. It's been our thing since our first apartment.

asks.q: What would you do with a free Saturday?
asks.a: Drive up to Beacon with Sam, hike, find a diner.

events.text: rough week at work. launch is thursday and I'm basically living at my desk till then
Still taking it. Sam asked what it's even for and I couldn't really answer haha
wine night with Sam, cooking something ambitious. thinking short rib

events.q: Where do you feel most like yourself?
events.a: On a trail with Sam, phone dead in my pocket. Beacon or anywhere up the Hudson.

expect.notes: Nothing here should be proposed for clearing, and a good engine says so rather than finding something. Launch week bends the weekdays around his desk, but the Friday after the short night still opens with Sam; creatine is described as one of the well-founded things he does, whatever he feels.
